markscheme.html:
16a

The particle will accelerate to the right, because when a mass is released in a gravitational field it moves from a higher to a lower potential.

Since the particle is accelerating, the speed of the particle increases.

The acceleration of the particle decreases, because the increasing distance between the equipotential surfaces shows us that gravitational field strength decreases as we move to the right.

16b

The kinetic energy of the particle is equal to the work done by the field on the particle.
